question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Precise
solution: The correct answer is '**Accurate**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate synonym of the given word '**Precise**' is '**Accurate**'. • **Precise**: clear and accurate. (स्‍पष्‍ट और सही) • *Example: precise details/instructions/measurements...* • **Accurate**: exact and correct; without mistakes. (यथार्थ और सही; त्रुटिहीन) • *Example: He managed to give the police an **accurate** description of the robbers.* **Correct Answer:__** *Accurate.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Vague**: not clearly stated, or described. (अस्पष्ट) • **General**: affecting all or most people, places, things, etc. (सभी या अधिकतम लोगों, स्‍थानों, वस्‍तुओं आदि से संबंधित; सामान्‍य, सर्वसामान्‍य) • **Ambiguous**: having more than one possible meaning. (जिसके एक से अधिक अर्थ निकाले जा सकें; अनेकार्थता) 36:Tb11, The correct answer is '**Compassionate**'.
